description: VENDORED, INFERRED. gifdex publishes no lexicon — gifdex.net does not resolve and there is no _lexicon TXT record for the NSID authority — so this is reconstructed from records in the wild. Kept deliberately permissive: only `media` is required, because a schema stricter than reality would make the indexer silently drop records it cannot validate.

title.description: Human-readable name; indexed for full-text search.

tags.description: Free-form tags; indexed for full-text search.

alt.description: Alt text. Often the richest description on the record, so it is indexed for full-text search.
